'''Isdain''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[Moff]] who served in the [[Galactic Empire]] during the [[Imperial Era]]. During this [[time]], Moff Isdain and seven other [[Imperial officer]]s, including [[Captain]] [[Gilad Pellaeon]], attended a briefing aboard an [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] in orbit above [[Coruscant]] that was escorted by four [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]]s. The briefing was conducted by [[Magistrate]] of [[Corvus]], [[Morgan Elsbeth]], and her design for the [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter]]. The Moff discounted Elsbeth's design because of how expensive it was, but thanked her for informing them that Corvus and the local [[star system]]s had an abundance of resources. Isdain instructed Elsbeth to prepare for the Empire's arrival in order to control her resources.<ref name="TPOA" />
